audit.summary: Theorem5 printed uniform extra boundary derivative is falsified by a smooth fully compatible subcritical high-frequency family. Proposition16's construction drops g1 and has inconsistent sign, failing even a stationary smooth example. Eq45 and Proposition6 fail for a smooth boundary pulse satisfying weak dissipativity; a corrected estimate is proved. Intended local existence/uniqueness not refuted.
